items.title: File Widerspruch against partial refusal of window permit
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Hansestadt Beispielwismar, Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (posting day) is 19.11.2026 (Thursday); the letter itself states the deemed-delivery rule it relies on: 'Ein Bescheid, den die Behörde mit einfachem Brief verschickt, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG M-V).' Adding 4 days to 19.11.2026 gives 23.11.2026 (Monday) as the day of deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after Bekanntgabe, i.e. 24.11.2026, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the start day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a normal working day in MV (not Saturday, Sunday or a public holiday), so no further shift is needed. The Widerspruch must reach the named office (Am Markt 1, 23966 Beispielwismar) by this date.

warnings: The letter states the 4-day deemed-delivery rule itself, but note that Mecklenburg-Vorpommern keeps an older 3-day rule (§ 120a VwVfG M-V) for matters that began before 1 January 2025; if the underlying application/hearing in this case predates 2025, the deadline could instead fall on 2026-12-22 — worth confirming with the Bürgermeisterin's office if in doubt.

If this letter was actually served formally (yellow envelope / Postzustellungsurkunde) rather than sent by ordinary post, the 4-day deemed-delivery rule stated in the letter would not apply and the one-month period would run instead from the actual service date.
